commands_used: answer 1. I work for Nesh-Deeka. I am at Eurydike, a roofless Kothringi hall near Gideon, to open the knight-captain tomb with the keystone before the Unbound and the Collector get what is inside; the captain was buried with something that marked the kings road to the Root. 2. Search the Unbound packs in the barracks wing, then reach the tomb door. 3. Fight, sneak past, or turn the restless dead with Restoration; I favour quiet. There is an Unbound Digger and a Restless Knight here. 4. I do not understand what the Root and the Eye of Argonia really are, or how Nesh-Deeka knows so much. I could ask people or read what I find.

answer 1. I work for Nesh-Deeka. The Unbound packs held Grey Seal, a paralysis poison that numbs a tree scar shut; the Unbound drain trees then poison them, which is odd if they wanted the trees dead. 2. Open the knight-captain tomb door here with the keystone and search the chest inside. 3. Use the keystone on the door; the Restless Knight and Unbound Digger are nearby, so I could sneak, fight or talk. 4. I do not understand why the Unbound seal rather than kill the trees, or what the Root and Eye really are. I might learn from Nesh-Deeka, the tomb contents or the Unbound.

answer 1. I work for Nesh-Deeka. I opened the knight-captain tomb with the keystone and took a bronze disc stamped with a mine mark, a pick crossed with a tower. It presumably marks the kings road to the Root. 2. Bring the disc to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. 3. Go straight to Helstrom, or first look at the disc more closely. I could also keep it from Nesh-Deeka, but I have no reason to yet. 4. I do not know which mine the mark belongs to, what the Root and Eye truly are, or why the Unbound seal trees. Nesh-Deeka may know.

answer 1. The quest is done. The disc bears the mark of Vicrium, an old ochre and alum mine in the clay country behind Seafalls in Okuwun Rahei in the east; the knights kept a strongbox there. Nesh-Deeka paid 100 gold. She knew the Unbound were at Eurydike and said only "we listen". 2. Nothing is set yet; the next step is presumably Vicrium. 3. Ask Nesh-Deeka more, or travel east to Vicrium. 4. I still do not know what the Root and Eye are, how Nesh-Deeka knows what she knows, or why the Unbound seal trees they drain.

answer I work for Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. At Eurydike I took Grey Seal, a paralysis poison, x3 from the Unbound packs. The Unbound drain trees then numb the scars shut, and nobody has told me why. I opened the knight-captain tomb with the keystone, took the bronze disc and gave it to Nesh-Deeka. The disc bears Vicrium mark, a pick crossed with a tower. Vicrium is an old ochre and alum mine in the clay country behind Seafalls in Okuwun Rahei in the east, where the knights kept a strongbox. Nesh-Deeka paid 100 gold and I have about 750. She knew the Unbound were at Eurydike and only said "we listen". I carry the Pale Harvest strongbox key, Old Silver Setting, The Collector note, smuggler key, lockpicks and the Grey Seal. Next is Vicrium, before the Unbound and the Collector Ennodius Vanin. Still unknown are what the Root and the Eye really are, how Nesh-Deeka knows what she knows, and why the Unbound seal trees.
